design: Identical costs, latent samples, reference/proposal densities and warm start per pair.
targets: Vehicle Tsallis uses adaptive normalization/cutoff; KL uses lambda=8. Scalar reference uses fixed transformed scale 0.8 for distinct targets.
inference: One-step commands and predicted costs, not executed driving or physical uncertainty.
support_note: support counts numerically nonzero weights. KL zeros can be floating-point underflow; only Tsallis has a finite-support cutoff.
